data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for editing and managing tags with auto-suggestions and Material behavior.
data.what_it_does: Provides a tag editor input field with built-in auto-suggestions, validation support, custom tag builders, and debounced input handling. Designed with Gmail-style tag inputs and keyboard accessibility shortcuts.
use_when: You need a Gmail-style tag input field with suggestions and validation.
Users need to add, delete, and navigate through multiple tags inline.
avoid_when: You only need a standard single-value TextField without tags.
You require complex non-Material styling outside the scope of custom builders.
strengths: Includes auto-suggestions with custom builder support.
Built-in debounced input and throttled callbacks.
Keyboard accessibility with Tab key shortcuts and arrow key navigation.
weaknesses: Limited to tag editing use cases.
Depends on external packages like pointer_interceptor and debounce_throttle.
